sentences.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像是由樱桃木雕刻而成的。

sentences.en: This carving knife ... it's one made by a famous swordsmith.
sentences.zh: 这把雕刻刀……是出自一位著名刀匠之手。

sentences.en: Pygmalion fell in love with the statue he had carved.
sentences.zh: 皮格马利翁爱上了他亲手雕琢的雕像。
